$comment: FEAT-20260911-001 — the Luna Watch guard.
Every declaration in `@theme static` as it stood at glass-ui@3d1c78e, which
is the commit the desk profile was cut from and the last thing Luna Watch
can have been built against. `tokens.spec.ts` asserts this map against the
live file: a value that moves fails, a token that disappears fails, and a
token that appears fails unless it is named in that file's ADDED list.
The desk profile is safe for Luna by construction — Luna never sets
`data-scale`, so no block under that attribute can reach it — but
'structural' is a claim, and this file is what turns it into a check. Do not
regenerate it from the current stylesheet to make a test pass: that inverts
the whole point. Change a value here only when a decision says the token's
no-attribute value is meant to move, and put the decision's name next to it.
JSON and not TypeScript on purpose: `tokens.spec.ts` forbids a colour
literal in any `.ts` or `.tsx` under `src/`, and a baseline of colours is
exactly that. It is data, and it is stored as data.
FEAT-20260919-618 — the material moved, on purpose. Eight `--glass-*` values
below are the liquid-glass measurement's, not 3d1c78e's; each is listed in
`decisions` with the decision that moved it, and `--glass-filter-strong` now
reads `--glass-blur-strong` instead of a literal. The six tokens the same
feature added are named in `tokens.spec.ts`'s ADDED list, where added tokens
belong. Everything not listed in `decisions` is still 3d1c78e's to the digit.
